head: 1f725cedc5c8b092c8a3d7e408793ef72840ec7e
notes: Known-ledger entries in this chunk were not re-reported (e.g. Makefile:81/83, bootstrap duplication, sync_skills jq repeat, squash git-log duplication, test grep&&fail, skill-invoke-gate tokenizer copy). Cross-direction suspicion for the station (not a code-style claim): cmd/hooks/skill-invoke-gate.sh:52 deny text tells the lane to invoke the skill '(bare, no args)', while railroad lanes must pass args="lane:<direction>" to receive their context-map slice (SKILL-RAILROADREVIEW-CTX-002a); a lane following the deny text literally gets the unmapped full-declaration fallback instead of its direction slice — worth a correctness/contracts look.

findings.fix: Extend the smine-nightly row to name the conditional fourth stage (/smine-orchestrate <run branch>, after publish, when ROUTINE_ORCHESTRATE=1 or audience: casual) and add ROUTINE_ORCHESTRATE and SMINE_DEV_MODE lines next to SMINE_AGENTS/SMINE_SUBAGENTS in the smine-apply vote-safety bullet.
findings.claim: The diff adds a stage-3 /smine-orchestrate run and two new env knobs (ROUTINE_ORCHESTRATE, SMINE_DEV_MODE) to routines/smine-nightly/run.sh, but routines/README.md — which the diff also edits to document SMINE_SUBAGENTS — still describes smine-nightly as 'three stages, one publish' and documents neither knob; the README's convention is that every smine-nightly env knob is listed (SMINE_APPLY_CAP, SMINE_AGENTS, SMINE_SUBAGENTS).
findings.evidence: Re-read routines/README.md at 1f725ce in full (see second finding for run.sh): line 14 row reads '... then /smine-apply <votes file> when votes are pending (three stages, one publish)'; lines 177-179 list SMINE_APPLY_CAP, SMINE_AGENTS and (new in this diff) SMINE_SUBAGENTS. git grep for ORCHESTRATE|orchestrate|SMINE_DEV_MODE over routines/README.md at the head returns nothing. routines/smine-nightly/run.sh lines 40-44 read SMINE_DEV_MODE and ROUTINE_ORCHESTRATE, lines 293-340 run the orchestrate stage. An operator configuring a developer install who wants the orchestrate stage finds no knob in the routines operations README. Distinct from known code-style-NIT-32-r2 (run.sh header comment) and correctness-MIN-19-r1 (skill-eval-fexplore row).

findings.fix: Change the append_result doc comment to '$2: stage (smine|smine-consolidate|apply|orchestrate)'.
findings.claim: append_result's doc comment declares its stage argument as '(smine|apply)', but the diff adds a fourth caller passing 'orchestrate' (line 325) next to the existing 'smine-consolidate' caller (line 193), so the declared value set no longer matches the stage labels written to results.jsonl.
findings.evidence: Re-read routines/smine-nightly/run.sh at 1f725ce in full: line 75 comment '# stdin: claude JSON envelope (may be empty, e.g. after timeout kill); $1: exit status; $2: stage (smine|apply)'; callers pass smine (113, 125, 134, 169), smine-consolidate (193), apply (236, 263) and, added by this diff, orchestrate (325). The sibling routines/skill-eval/run.sh:22-23 keeps its stage list (cells|eval) exact, which is the in-repo convention. No functional effect — cosmetic.
